title: ApprovalDelegation - Data API
description: Represents an approval delegation that transfers a user's approval responsibilities to another user, group, or queue for a specified date range. This object is available in API version 68.0 and later.

Comments.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Comments.description: The comments added by the user creating the delegation record.

DelegatedFromUserId.description: The ID of the user delegating their approval responsibilities to another user, group, or queue. This field is a relationship field.

DelegatedToId.description: The ID of the user, group, or queue receiving the delegated approval responsibilities. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

EndDate.description: The date and time when the delegation becomes inactive, adjusted according to the delegator's timezone. If left empty, the delegation remains active indefinitely.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The auto-generated name of the approval delegation record, for example AD-000000001.

StartDate.description: The date and time when the delegation becomes active, adjusted according to the delegator's timezone.

special_access_rules: This object is available in Enterprise, Unlimited, and Developer Editions where Advanced Approvals is enabled.
associated_objects: ApprovalDelegationHistory: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
